messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - HIGH: GPU allocation failures detected in gcp-asia-east1 (region). autoscaler is failing to create nodes, queue growing. link: https://console.redwood.example/ops/5178901234
incident-bot: Symptoms: request queue ~18k, 503 spike ~22% over last 5m, avg latency tokens slowed. Autoscaler error: "RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: GPUs quota exceeded for project". See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/gpu-quota-hit
samir: oncall here, acked. I'm pulling autoscaler logs now. Starting mitigation checklist.
emily: thanks Samir. quick status: which pools are impacted? is this a single zone failure or region-wide? any customer-facing outages yet?
samir: Looks region-wide for asia-east1. Pools in asia-east1-c & -b both deny new GPU VMs. Old nodes healthy but can't scale. Customer impact: some requests are queued and 503s for best-effort tier; dedicated/reserved customers unaffected. cs reported 2 customers seeing increased error rates.
marta: copying logs from autoscaler: ```2026-02-12T11:04:12Z autoscaler: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_T4' exceeded in region asia-east1 for project 12345```
james: devops idea: can we reroute traffic for non-SLA tiers to us-west1 hot spare pool? route policy exists but need to ensure model variants compatible.
emily: yes, we can route non-reserved to us-west1 but need to double-check latency implications. Samir, can you flip a canary route for 10%?
samir: initiating canary reroute 10% non-reserved -> us-west1. Command: `rdctl routing set --from=asia-east1 --to=us-west1 --percent=10 --matcher="tier!=reserved"`
devops-bot: routing change queued. Will apply after preflight checks.
devops-bot: preflight ok. route applied. monitoring 2m.
samir: canary green for 2m. throughput stable for canary. increasing to 40% now.
marta: meanwhile attempted warm-pool creation but gcloud returned: ```ERROR: (compute.instances.insert) ResponseError: code=403, message=Quota 'GPUS' exceeded.```
emily: ok warm pools blocked. Next tactic: enable CPU-only fallback for low-priority workloads + reduce batch sizes to free KV cache memory. Samir, can you push fallback policy?
samir: pushed fallback: `policy:fallback-to-cpu where tier==free or tier==beta` and reduced max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for asia-east1. Changes live.
james: also starting temporary token-based rate limit for anonymous/free keys: 1r/s. config snippet: ```routes:
  - match: tier==free
    rate_limit: 1rps
```
customer-success: CS team prepping a public status update draft: "Partial degradation in asia-east1 affecting free accounts; dedicated customers not impacted. Working with cloud provider." Want exact ETA before posting.
emily: ETA depends on quota increase. Samir, did you open a support ticket with GCP?
samir: opened support case: case: 20260212-7890. Requested quota bump for `NVIDIA_T4` in asia-east1 from 80 -> 200. Included urgency: production impact. Filed escalation to GCP quota team (phone).
marta: GCP response: initial acknowledgement 11:12Z, engineering review requested. Could be 1-6 hours.
james: while we wait, propose we enable a temporary model-quantized variant in-region (4-bit quantized) to reduce GPU footprint per instance. That will allow serving more concurrent sessions on existing GPUs. Emily ok?
emily: yes, roll quantized variant for non-reserved traffic only. Ensure output quality test set passes quick smoke (use eval preset).
samir: rolling quantized variant to non-reserved pools now. Smoke eval: 98/100 checks passed. Throttling still happening but per-GPU concurrency improved ~1.8x. Queue dropped from 18k -> 6k in 12m.
incident-bot: Update: queue decreased 67% since mitigations started. 503s down to 6%.
james: note: we still have misrouted requests hitting original asia-east1, put a circuit breaker: if queue > 5k then reject low-priority with 429. Pushed circuit rule.
marta: also observed an unrelated SRE job (oom-kill) consuming ephemeral GPUs in project: `build-runner-42` — I've suspended that job to free 2 GPUs.
emily: nice catch. That freed capacity and helped.
customer-success: CS drafting status v1: "We are investigating GPU allocation errors in asia-east1 impacting best-effort customers. We have mitigations in place including cross-region routing and fallbacks. Will update in 30 minutes." Approving to post.
samir: posting update now.
incident-bot: Public status update posted: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/asia-east1-2026-02-12
emily: we should also prepare a post-incident customer comms for affected customers summarizing root cause (provider GPU quota exhausted), timeline, mitigations, and CTA for reserved capacity. Marta can you draft?
marta: on it. Also adding TOOLS: add a new alert threshold to detect quota-denied errors specifically: alert if autoscaler create failure contains 'quotaExceeded' > 5 in 5m.
james: opened internal follow-up: document will include runbook improvements: pre-warm hot-spares in different region, add reserve tokens for quick quota increases, and automate cross-region failover for non-reserved.
samir: GCP update: case escalated to quota manager, they requested exact VMs and projects; provided. They estimate approval within 90-180 minutes.
emily: current impact: non-reserved request success rate now ~94%, latency normalized for canary routes but warmup still ongoing. Dedicated unaffected. Prioritized customers unaffected.
customer-success: CS will send targeted email to the 2 customers who reported errors with timeline and mitigation steps.
marta: keeping this open as a pager until quota increase completes or normal autoscaling restored. Adding followup ticket: INT-2026-045_gpu_quota_postmortem.
incident-bot: SUMMARY: Root cause: provider-side GPU quota exhausted in gcp-asia-east1 leading to autoscaler failures. Mitigations: cross-region routing, quantized model variant, reduced batch sizes, suspend noisy jobs, rate limits. Ongoing: GCP quota increase pending (case 20260212-7890). Next update in 20m.
samir: leaving shift in 30m; oncall handoff to Emily at 12:00Z. Emily will take primary.
emily: acknowledged handoff. I will continue monitoring and coordinate with CS.
incident-bot: Handoff noted: oncall -> emily at 12:00Z.
incident-bot: LAST UPDATE: 12:24Z - queue 1.2k, 503s 1.5%. Keeping incident channel open until quota resolved.
